sourceRefs.locator: Inv. 56.449, Description, Mesures and Mode d’acquisition: gold and garnet, loop for fastening, 1.6 cm, 1.95 g, reported numbers at discovery and presentation, two recovered after the theft.
p. 39, introduction and fig. 1 with caption: discovery by A. Quinquin, recovery by the parish chaplain, cemetery and position of the horse pits in the Saint-Brice neighbourhood.

note.de: Die kleine schematische Fläche bezeichnet das Viertel am Fundort. Das Grabungsareal und der frühmittelalterliche Friedhof hatten andere Grenzen.
note.en: The small schematic area locates the neighbourhood around the find. The excavation trenches and the early medieval cemetery had different boundaries.

note.de: In seinem Bericht erwähnt Chifflet zahlreiche Insekten aus dem Grab. Der heutige Katalog kann einzelne erhaltene Stücke nachweisen.
note.en: Chifflet reported many insects from the grave. The present catalogue identifies individual survivors.
